id: P8d implementation of the already-declared finalist checks
selection: Each chain's lowest existing v3 cost, as specified in its frozen search plan. Report every trajectory, including numerical failures. Do not substitute another finalist after marine/finer/stress results.
marine_scope: Fresh r44 and all three cost-best profiles on the same known six coasts; compare SST and air monthly curves separately. Not an ocean energy-budget validation.
qualifier: Only cost-best profiles satisfying S49<=0.995, T_relative<=0.01 and P_relative<=0.01 receive the additional paired development checks.
checks: Fresh matched r44/candidate 49-region replay, fixed four-region 28-km test, then all spent-h regions as a stress test. Reference runs may be shared across finalists. Require search error-pair replay within 1e-10 and actual case hashes/cell counts equal. Retain failed checks; do not tune or adopt from them.
adoption: None in this campaign. h/f/g are spent; no new independent pool is opened. r44/v2.2 atlas and its correction models remain published.
